section.name: Introduction
section.p: The QRCode library provides functionalities to generate and manage QR codes within the Lutece platform.

section.name: Configuration
section.p: To configure the QRCode library, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Include the library in your project dependencies.
Initialize the QRCodeService in your application.

section.name: Usage
section.p: To use the QRCode library, follow these steps:

itemizedlist.item: Call the QRCodeService to generate a QR code.
Specify the text or URL to be encoded into the QR code.
Set the desired size and error correction level for the QR code.
Retrieve the generated QR code image.
